{{Quote|The Dread Masters have violated an Imperial stronghold and stolen powers they cannot control.|[[Darth Acina]]|<ref name="TOR-DA" />}}
Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tagriss]] staged a '''raid''' on the [[Arcanum]], a facility maintained by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to contain dangerous [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]], in order to steal some relics on behalf of the [[Dread Masters]]. A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strike team was sent to defend the facility for the Empire while the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched a strike team of their own to prevent Tagriss from succeeding with his mission, but despite their efforts Tagriss was able to escape with the [[Darkstaff]] and the [[Seeds of Rage]].
